ns2:course.label: Seminar Genres - Forms
ns2:course.description: Study of a form (the lyric, the novel, the drama, etc.) to discover its essential components in all the literatures studied and the significance of national variations. May be repeated to a maximum of 12 hours if topics vary.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated to a maximum of 12 hours if topics vary.
